spans.s:
A word ending in the Locative -7th-case-affix is compounded with the words शौण्ड 'skilled' etc. and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

A word with the seventh case-affix and an epithet are to be placed first in the बहुव्रीही compound.

Terms: समास-द्वन्द्व-अच्

A noun denoting time or place gets the affix of the 7th or the 5th case when the sense applied is that the time or space is the interval between one action and another (or implies an interval of time and space between कारक-s.

Terms: विभक्ति-5, 7
The 7th case-affix is used when the sense is that of location -- आधारोऽधिकरणम्

, as well as after the words meaning 'distant' and 'near'.

Terms: विभक्ति-7

The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when the word, in composition with it is in the Locative -7th-case.

Terms: ड

The affix णमुल् comes after the roots 1. पीड् 'to press' 2. रुद्ध् 'to obstruct' 3. कृष् 'to draw' when they are preceded by the preposition उप and when they are compounded with nouns ending with the Locative -7th case-affix.

Terms: णमुल्

The affix अञ् (+/- अ) comes after the word सप्तन् in the छन्दस् (Vedas) when the meaning is that of a वर्ग।

Terms: अञ्

The word साप्तपदीन is anomalous when meaning 'friendship'.

Terms: Anomalous

The affix इनि (इन्) comes in the sense of 'by whom something is done' after the word पूर्व, also when another word precedes it.

Terms: इनि (इन्)

The affix त्रल् comes after किम् , सर्वनाम and बहु when ending in Locative -7th case.

Terms: त्रल्

The affix डाच् comes after the words 1. सपत्त्र and 2. निष्पत्र followed by the verb कृ 'to make' when the sense is that of causing intense pain.

Terms: डाच्

When a word ending in the Locative -7th case does not denote time preserves its original accent when followed by 1. सिद्ध 2. शुष्क 3. पक्व and 4. बन्ध in a compound.

Terms: द्विगु समास

If the first member of a compound is in the Locative -7th case or denoting the name of the Receiver of Tax, has acutely accented (उदात्त) first syllable, when the second member is a word denoting 'what is lawful', but not when it is हरण।

Terms: समास 1st-acute

The word पुण्य has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by a Noun in the Locative -7th case.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

Of a भ अङ्ग (stem) ending in अन् with a preceding ष as well as of हन् and धृतराजन् , the अ is elided before the affix अण् ।

Terms: अ elision

When the affix शतृ (अत्-अन्त्) comes after a verbal अङ्ग (stem) ending in विकरण-s शप् and श्यन् it invariably takes the augment नुम् before the Neutral शी (ई) and the feminine ending ई (नदी).

Terms: नुम् augment

When the सर्वनाम follows a Nominative 1st-Case, which itself is preceded by another word, then the above substitutions may take place optionally.

Terms: सर्वनाम
